Subject: Insurance requirements for Redwood MSA - HelixCloud

Marissa —

Thanks for sending the draft Order Form. Procurement at HelixCloud ran the standard insurance checklist and had a couple of clarifying asks before we can sign:

- Limits: Our broker saw the MSA lists 1M/2M/5M (GL/AGG/PL). Can you confirm Redwood requires 1M per occurrence / 2M aggregate? We sometimes need to reconcile with our marketplace limits.
- Additional insured: Our legal needs the exact "Additional Insured" wording to present to our broker. Can Redwood confirm the name(s) to be named on the COI and whether an endorsement is required (primary and non-contributory, waiver of subrogation, etc.)?
- Timeline: Broker needs a confirmation note to produce certificate + endorsement. Would Redwood accept COI first and endorsement within 3 business days?

I attached our internal summary of requirements (Helix_REQS_insurance_summary_20270518.pdf). If you prefer, loop in your insurance contact and we can coordinate with AlliedBrokers (cc'd).

Thanks —
Sam Turner
Senior Procurement Manager, HelixCloud
sam.turner@helixcloud.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@helixcloud.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T11:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Insurance requirements for Redwood MSA - HelixCloud

Sam —

Appreciate the clear list. Short answers here and I'll let our legal confirm the exact endorsement language:

- Limits: Redwood's standard is Commercial General Liability 1,000,000 each occurrence / 2,000,000 aggregate; Auto 1,000,000 combined single limit; Employers' Liability 1,000,000; If HelixCloud needs higher limits for Marketplace onboarding, we can discuss.
- Additional insured: Redwood requires HelixCloud to name "Redwood Inference, Inc." as Additional Insured on the CGL policy. We typically require an Additional Insured endorsement (ISO CG 20 10 or equivalent) on a primary and non-contributory basis for liabilities arising out of HelixCloud's acts or omissions.
- Waiver of subrogation: Generally acceptable where allowed by law; we'll confirm.
- Timeline: COI first + endorsement within 3 business days is acceptable in most cases.

Looping in Aditya (legal) for confirmation of the endorsement wording and whether we need AWS or other parties named for Marketplace transactions. Karthik — can you confirm if this flow affects the Order Form redlines or acceptance criteria?

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Subject: Re: Insurance requirements for Redwood MSA - HelixCloud

Marissa / Sam —

Confirmed from Legal. We can accept the following, which should be sufficient for your broker to prepare the COI + endorsement:

1) Limits: CGL $1,000,000 per occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate; Auto $1,000,000; Employers' Liability $1,000,000.
2) Additional Insured: HelixCloud will procure an Additional Insured endorsement naming: "Redwood Inference, Inc. and its officers, directors and employees" as Additional Insured with respect to liability arising out of HelixCloud's operations. Endorsement should be the equivalent of ISO CG 20 10 (or CG 20 26 where available) on a primary & non-contributory basis for claims covered by the insured's policy.
3) Waiver of Subrogation: Acceptable for CGL where permitted by law; please include waiver on the COI/endorsement if broker confirms.
4) Evidence delivery: COI acceptable to be provided at signing; endorsement to follow within 3 business days. If the endorsement naming requires carrier approval that may take longer, please flag.

Note: We do not require Professional Liability for this Order Form unless HelixCloud is providing professional services under a separate SOW.

Marissa — this language is what we should insert into the Order Form redline (insurance section). Karthik / Kimberly, please confirm the Order Form will accept a clause pointing to MSA insurance requirements or if we need to inline the full text.

-Aditya
